project.name: Uber
project.description: Promise-Driven Development refactor of Uber ride-sharing product promises

productPromises.statement: As a Rider, get a reliable ride from A to B in minutes.
productPromises.description: Core promise of on-demand transportation with minimal wait time and guaranteed completion.

epics.description: Enable riders to set pickup, destination, and confirm request in few taps.

journeys.description: User who has never used Uber before and needs guidance.

flows.statement: Sign up and request first ride
flows.description: Complete registration and place first ride request.

moments.statement: Enter phone number
Verify via SMS code
Add payment method (credit card or PayPal) so that rides can be billed for Rider.
moments.description: Coordination with payment gateway to store tokenized payment info.

moments.statement: Set pickup location (auto-detect or manually drag map)
Confirm ride request

journeys.description: User taking same route repeatedly, wants fast repeat requests.

moments.statement: Open Uber app
Tap 'Home' or 'Work' shortcut
Suggested destination (e.g., work) auto-fills so that Rider saves time.
moments.description: System predicts destination based on time and history.

moments.statement: Tap 'Confirm'

journeys.description: User needing ride from airport with luggage and flight tracking.

flows.description: Book ride in advance to align with flight arrival.

moments.statement: Enter airport as pickup
Select 'Schedule for later'
Pick date and time
Flight is monitored so that driver arrival adjusts for delays for Rider.
moments.description: System integrates with flight tracking to reschedule pickup.

epics.description: Find nearest available driver and confirm assignment.

journeys.description: User requesting ride during high demand, may face longer matching.

flows.description: System searches and updates rider on status.

moments.statement: Request is sent to nearby drivers
View 'Finding a driver' animation
Driver accepts so that trip is confirmed for Rider.
moments.description: Matching algorithm pairs rider with accepting driver.

moments.statement: See driver name, photo, car model, and ETA

journeys.description: User requiring WAV (wheelchair accessible vehicle) or special assistance.

flows.description: Filter driver matching to only wheelchair-accessible vehicles.

moments.statement: Select 'UberWAV' from ride options
Matching is restricted to WAV-certified drivers so that accessibility promise is kept for Rider.
Confirm ride with accessible vehicle

epics.statement: Track driver arrival in real time
epics.description: Show driver location on map and accurate ETA.

journeys.statement: Rider waiting at busy street corner
journeys.description: User needs to identify car among traffic.

flows.statement: Monitor live map and car details

moments.statement: View live moving car icon on map
See countdown timer for arrival
Receive push notification when driver is 1 minute away

epics.statement: Complete trip with accurate fare and rating
epics.description: End ride, process payment, and allow feedback.

journeys.description: User exiting vehicle and receiving final charge.

flows.description: Post-trip screen with rating stars and receipt.

moments.statement: Trip ends so that fare is calculated for Rider.
moments.description: System computes final fare based on distance and time.

moments.statement: Payment is charged automatically so that no action is needed for Rider.
Rate driver 1-5 stars and optionally tip
Receipt is emailed and available in app history for Rider.

productPromises.statement: As a Rider, pay a fair price with no surprises.
productPromises.description: Transparent upfront pricing, no hidden fees, and clear surge indication.

epics.description: Show price before requesting ride, including breakdown.

flows.description: See UberX, UberPool, UberXL with estimated fares.

moments.statement: Enter pickup and destination
Fare estimates are shown for each product type so that Rider can choose best value.
moments.description: Pricing engine computes estimates including surge.

moments.statement: Select cheapest option (e.g., UberPool)

journeys.description: User facing higher prices due to demand.

flows.description: Clear surge notification and option to delay.

moments.statement: Surge alert appears: 'Prices are higher due to demand'
See exact multiplied fare (e.g., 1.5x)
Choose 'Notify me when price drops' to wait

epics.description: Divide trip cost among multiple riders.

flows.description: Request split, send requests to friends.

moments.statement: After trip ends, tap 'Split Fare'
Select contacts from phone or Uber app
Split request is sent so that friends can pay their share for Rider.
moments.description: System sends push notifications and handles partial payments.

epics.description: Detailed breakdown of fare, taxes, fees, and adjustments.

journeys.description: User requires detailed receipt for reimbursement.

flows.description: Access trip history and export receipt.

moments.statement: Go to 'Your Trips' in app
Select specific trip
Receipt PDF is generated with fare breakdown and taxes so that Rider can submit expenses.
moments.description: PDF generation service pulls trip data.

moments.statement: Tap 'Share' to email or save PDF

productPromises.statement: As a Rider, feel safe throughout every trip.
productPromises.description: Provide safety features like share trip, emergency button, and driver verification.

epics.statement: Share trip status with trusted contacts
epics.description: Allow rider to share live location and trip details.

flows.description: Send SMS or app link with live tracking.

moments.statement: After driver assigned, tap 'Share trip status'
Select contact from address book
Tracking link is generated and sent so that contact can monitor trip for Rider.
moments.description: System creates expiring shareable URL with live map.

epics.description: In-app button to call 911 or Uber safety line.

flows.description: Immediate access to 911 and safety features.

moments.statement: Tap shield icon on app map screen
Select 'Emergency' from menu
Emergency call is placed with trip details (location, driver info) so that Rider gets help fast.

epics.description: Show driver photo, license plate, and rating before and during trip.

journeys.description: User verifying vehicle matches app details.

flows.description: Clear display of car details and PIN code optional.

moments.statement: View driver details: photo, name, rating, license plate
See car model and color in app
(Optional) Receive 4-digit verification code to provide to driver
moments.description: Extra layer to ensure correct driver.

productPromises.statement: As a Driver, earn money on my own schedule.
productPromises.description: Flexible earning opportunity with transparent pay and instant cash out.

epics.statement: Go online and receive trip requests
epics.description: Driver can toggle availability and get matched.

journeys.description: User completing signup and starting first shift.

moments.statement: Upload driver's license photo
Upload vehicle insurance and registration
Background check is processed so that Driver is approved for safety.
Toggle 'Go Online' button

flows.description: Incoming ride requests with fare and distance.

moments.statement: Hear 'New trip request' sound and see notification
View pickup location, distance, and estimated fare
Tap 'Accept' within 15 seconds

epics.statement: Track earnings and cash out instantly
epics.description: View daily earnings, tips, and transfer to bank.

journeys.description: User wants to withdraw earnings before weekly payout.

flows.description: Transfer balance to debit card instantly for a fee.

moments.statement: Open Earnings tab
Tap 'Cash Out'
Funds are transferred to linked debit card so that Driver has instant access.

journeys.description: User analyzing earnings by hour and location.

moments.statement: Go to Earnings > History
Select date range
Summary of net earnings, tips, and online hours is displayed so that Driver can track performance.
